svg.title: Symmetric binomial products contain only even powers
svg.desc: Multiplying one plus x to the fourth power by one minus x to the fourth power equals one minus x squared to the fourth power. Its expansion is one minus four x squared plus six x to the fourth minus four x to the sixth plus x to the eighth. The coefficient of x to the fourth is six. The coefficient of x cubed is zero, because its four contributions negative four, twenty-four, negative twenty-four and four cancel.
